# RN-Dubai — ROWAD ALNAJAH For Food & Beverages Trading Co. L.L.C (رواد النجاح)

> RN-Dubai (Rowad Alnajah) is a Dubai-based frozen food supplier and trading company serving importers and wholesalers in the Middle East, Africa and Europe. Range: frozen and smoked fish, frozen meat and poultry, IQF vegetables and fruits. Prices are not published; price offers are given on request.

Website: https://www.rn-dubai.com (English) · https://www.rn-dubai.com/ar (Arabic)
Sales: info@rn-dubai.com · +971501029662
Management: ceo@rn-dubai.com
Address: Zalfa Building, Al Garhoud, Plot No. 165-0, Property No. 308-103, Dubai, UAE
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/rn-dubai/

## Company
- [About Us](https://www.rn-dubai.com/about-us): who we are and how we trade
- [Contact Us / Request a Quote](https://www.rn-dubai.com/contact-us): price offers for importers and wholesalers
- [Insights](https://www.rn-dubai.com/insights): news, exhibitions and buyer guides

## Products
- [All products](https://www.rn-dubai.com/products)
- [Frozen Fish](https://www.rn-dubai.com/products/frozen-fish): herring, hake, horse mackerel, Pacific mackerel, sardine, tilapia, yellowtail
- [Smoked & Cured Fish](https://www.rn-dubai.com/products/smoked-fish): smoked herring (also with roe, Icelandic, vacuum-packed), vacuum-packed smoked mackerel, feseekh
- [Frozen Meat](https://www.rn-dubai.com/products/frozen-meat): beef, lamb, mutton
- [Frozen Poultry](https://www.rn-dubai.com/products/frozen-poultry): whole chicken, breast, legs, wings
- [Frozen Vegetables](https://www.rn-dubai.com/products/frozen-vegetables): molokhia, okra, spinach, peas, green beans, broccoli, vine leaves and more
- [Frozen Fruits](https://www.rn-dubai.com/products/frozen-fruits): strawberries, mango, guava, dates, figs, pomegranate arils, apricots, fruit pulps
